title: BGP Session Flap — dc1-leaf2a and dc1-leaf2b EVPN to spines
symptom: BGP alarms on dc1-leaf2a (100.68.0.15) and dc1-leaf2b (100.68.0.16). EVPN sessions to both spines dropped to Connect state.
root_cause: EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password set to WRONG_PASSWORD on both dc1-leaf2a and dc1-leaf2b
fix_command:
router bgp 65102
neighbor EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password 7 Q4fqtbqcZ7oQuKfuWtNGRQ==
